description: 3-page real-world TCPDF-generated document (a table-of-contents front page + two body pages). Object 7 is 'AAAAAE+DejaVuSans', an embedded, subsetted CID TrueType font under Identity-H encoding (confirmed via `pdffonts`: emb=yes sub=yes uni=yes) used for the heading text; the Standard-14 fonts (Helvetica/Times-Bold/Helvetica-Bold, objects 3/4/6) carry the rest. Every page also carries a 'page N / 3' footer line and page 3 carries a 'Powered by TCPDF' footer — incidental but genuine header/footer coverage (see category note: this fixture's primary bucket is truetype-embedded-identity-h; header-footer is a secondary, real bonus rather than a separately-authored fixture).

oracle.method: poppler pdftotext -f/-l per-page (independent third-party extractor, never PlumePdf); pdffonts for the font-table facts cited above.
oracle.notes: pdftotext -f N -l N basicapi.pdf - for N in 1..3.
